scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Mizeria (Polish Cucumber Salad): cucumber, salt, dill, sour cream, lemon juice, white sugar, black pepper.

Step 1 of Mizeria (Polish Cucumber Salad): Place cucumbers into a colander and sprinkle generously with salt; let stand until soft, about 5 minutes. Squeeze liquid from cucumbers and transfer to a bowl with dill..

Step 2 of Mizeria (Polish Cucumber Salad): Mix sour cream, lemon juice, and sugar together in a bowl; add to cucumbers and toss to coat. Season with pepper. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving..
